errors.evidence: The description swaps the values for "Строителство" (Construction) and "Индустрия" (Industry) in the second chart. The chart shows Industry has 21% (33.0 million) and Construction has 9% (13.4 million), but the description states the opposite.

errors.text_span: „Оборот“, показва, че „Други услуги“ има най-голям дял с 31% (9,9 трлн.)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that "Други услуги" (Other Services) has the largest share in the "Оборот" (Turnover) chart. The chart shows that "Индустрия" (Industry) has the largest share with 33%.

errors.text_span: „Други услуги“ има най-голям дял с 31% (9,9 трлн.), последван от „Индустрия“ с 33% (10,6 трлн.), „Търговия“ с 31% (9,8 трлн.)
errors.evidence: The absolute values for "Други услуги" (Other Services) and "Търговия" (Trade) in the Turnover chart are swapped. The chart shows Other Services has a turnover of 9.8 trillion and Trade has a turnover of 9.9 trillion, but the description states 9.9 trillion for Other Services and 9.8 trillion for Trade.
The charts are donut charts, not pie charts, as they have a hole in the center. While 'кръгови диаграми' (circular charts) is a general term, it is less precise.
